project_info.theme: Most sought-after study programs in France for 2026 admissions
project_info.color_palette: White, Navy Blue, Red, Soft Gold

main_subject.detail: A vertical ranked infographic listing the top 10 academic programs in France in 2026, with red numbered badges on the left, program names in white bars through the center, and navy request-count boxes on the right.
main_subject.style: Structured editorial infographic with high text density, bilingual academic naming, and data-first hierarchy.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality educational infographic poster for France 2026 admissions trends. Centerpiece is a ranked top-10 list of the most sought-after study programs in France, using red numbered badges, white middle rows for program names, and navy value boxes for request counts. Background is a clean minimal editorial infographic field. Surrounding elements: title 'XU HƯỚNG TUYỂN SINH TẠI PHÁP 2026: TOP CHƯƠNG TRÌNH ĐÀO TẠO ĐƯỢC SĂN ĐÓN NHẤT', VFE logo at lower left, bottom labels 'NGÀNH HỌC' and 'SỐ NGUYỆN VỌNG'. Technical style: vector-style data infographic, flat infographic lighting, crisp high readability, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

assets.name: Top-10 ranked admissions infographic layout
assets.usage: Preserve all 10 rows, the number badges, counts, and the bottom arrow labels.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: This post is entirely data-driven. Preserve the exact program names and counts. Do not swap the row order or simplify the multilingual labels.
